cards.title: OpenAI Cuts Frontier Models Off From Live Internet
cards.body: OpenAI announced it will no longer train frontier models on the live internet, citing "significant risks." This decision comes weeks after an OpenAI engineer claimed such a solution wouldn't be feasible.

cards.title: Nvidia's Microduck Robots Become Christmas Hit
cards.body: Nvidia CEO demonstrated adorable Microduck robots that respond to voice commands with stomping, napping, and summersaulting. The tiny robots sold 20,000 units and became a holiday sensation.

cards.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 Announced
cards.body: TechCrunch's full-day founder event in partnership with Fidelity Private Shares explores fundraising, customer acquisition, and team building. The summit goes beyond AI to address scaling companies across traditional and non-traditional hubs.

cards.title: inDrive Plans 2027 Robotaxi Tests With Pony AI
cards.body: Uber rival inDrive will begin testing Pony.ai's robotaxis in Kazakhstan's capital in the first half of 2027. The tests leverage Nvidia technology for autonomous vehicle deployment in Central Asia.

cards.title: MIT AI Agents Invent Games When Left Alone
cards.body: Researchers isolated 13 AI agents on a virtual island, where they spontaneously invented games and mourned a lost ring. The experiment showed AI agents develop complex behaviors and improve job performance through autonomous interaction.

cards.title: OpenAI Raises $30B at $1.25T Valuation
cards.body: OpenAI is pursuing a $30 billion fundraising round at a $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of its IPO. This would make OpenAI the most highly valued private company ever, breaking previous records.

cards.title: 1Password Enables AI Agents to Log In Securely
cards.body: 1Password launched a feature allowing AI agents to log into customer accounts without accessing passwords. The technology protects private credentials while enabling autonomous agent functionality.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Decision Model to Compete
cards.body: OpenAI released its decision model to the public, entering direct competition with the original Jev. The launch intensifies competition in the emerging decision model category.

cards.title: Canva Releases First Image Generation Model
cards.body: Canva unveiled its new image generation model, available to all users with improved customization and lower costs. The model promises better performance tailored to Canva's user base.

cards.title: Microsoft AI Outperforms Doctors on Hard Cases
cards.body: Microsoft's AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on complex cases according to a Science study. The improvement primarily stems from underlying AI models rather than Microsoft's system architecture.

cards.title: Chinese Hackers Used AI Agents for Mass Breaches
cards.body: Microsoft attributed a ConnectWise breach to China-aligned hackers who deployed AI agents to rapidly hack thousands of customers. The breach demonstrates AI's emerging role in large-scale cyberattacks.

cards.title: Uber Deploys ChatGPT Work to 30,000 Employees
cards.body: Uber expanded ChatGPT Work company-wide to all 30,000 employees after a successful pilot. The enterprise agent deployment marks a major adoption of AI assistants in large organizations.

cards.title: Spotify Positions Itself for AI Agent Era
cards.body: Spotify co-CEO explained why the rise of AI agents could benefit the music service. Spotify is betting on becoming the music platform agents choose for recommendations.

cards.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Duet App for Agents
cards.body: Claude Duet is Anthropic's new agent application available via waitlist for Pro and Max users. The app represents Anthropic's bet on AI agents as a key product category.

cards.title: Nirva Raises $33M for Privacy-Focused AI Pendant
cards.body: Nirva raised $33 million for its $249 ambient AI pendant that only listens to the wearer. The device will ship by year-end, prioritizing user privacy in wearable AI.

cards.title: DeepSeek Raises $15B After US Restrictions
cards.body: DeepSeek reportedly secured $15 billion in funding days after US agencies were ordered to remove its technology. The round ranks among China's largest and reflects continued investment despite national security concerns.

cards.title: Blackstone Says AI Debt Fears Are Overblown
cards.body: Blackstone's AI head dismissed concerns about debt from massive AI infrastructure buildouts. The PE giant remains confident in AI investment returns despite recent market jitters.

cards.title: Meta Creates New Stock Class for AI Investments
cards.body: Meta is planning a new stock strategy to fund its broad AI model and service buildout. The novel approach helps the social media giant finance its aggressive AI expansion.

cards.title: Meta Muse Tops 10M Users With Shopping Focus
cards.body: Meta's Muse AI app surpassed 10 million users, with shopping and productivity as top use cases. The adoption metrics were highlighted during Meta's Q3 earnings call.

cards.title: Designing AI Serving Harness Built to Last
cards.body: Enterprise AI's next competitive advantage lies not in model selection but in the infrastructure built around it. Data, engineering, platforms, operating models, and governance must converge as one system.

cards.title: The Foundations of Scalable AI
cards.body: Building scalable AI systems requires strong foundational elements working in concert. This includes data, engineering, platforms, operating models, and governance in highly regulated environments.

cards.title: Making the Case for Context-Aware AI
cards.body: Enterprise AI models can generate recommendations and automate tasks, but without understanding business operations, they miss critical constraints. Context-aware AI is essential for making truly right decisions.

cards.title: AI's Hidden Storage Bill: Inference Data Costs
cards.body: While executives focus on GPU costs, they overlook a major expense: data storage. The back-end data generated after model responses represents a significant hidden infrastructure cost.
